acceptanceCriteria: STRV0015 and STRV0014 assert the per-shard budget through the injected clock, not real sleeps
the per-invocation-deadline mutation (run.go WithTimeout(ctx, budget)) still fails STRV0015
body: Residual from the V1-1439 lane (PR #942, head d3ad79e6a). The fix widened margins: the slow fake go sleeps 7 s against a 12 s STRV0015 shard budget and STRV0014 uses a 10 s budget. Still wall-clock based, so heavy load can flake them again. PR #937 (V1-1311) adds a `now` clock seam in the session runner; once it lands, STRV0015/0014 should use it instead of sleeps.
